title: add nav class to minitabstrip panels so shiny tab input binding works
Fix wrong value argument passed to tabPanel() by miniTabPanel()
description: `miniTabPanel()` systematically pass the `title` argument to `tabPanel()`'s `value`, whereas it should pass its own `value` argument instead.

title: Change miniContentPanel padding to 15px
description:
This looks slightly worse IMHO, but makes it possible to use fluidRow
inside a miniContentPanel without causing a spurious horizontal
scrollbar to appear.

title: Add cancel button, gadget title bar
description: Add two functions to provide better baseline behavior for Shiny gadgets, by adding a Cancel button to the title bar that can be invoked by click or by hitting Escape.
